test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in the following sentence.

The patient complained of **giddiness **after surgery.
solution:
The correct answer is 'unsteadiness'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym for the given word 'giddiness' is 'unsteadiness'.
 
• The meaning of the word 'giddiness' is '**a sensation of whirling and a tendency to fall or stagger; dizziness**'.
 
• The meaning of the word 'unsteadiness' is '**Loss of one's equilibrium in regard to the environment, often with a feeling of almost falling, or the result of bumping into things**'.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'unsteadiness'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Opponent- someone who competes with or opposes another in a contest, game, or argument.
 
• Enthusiasm- intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
• Pride- consciousness of one's own dignity.
